GpsDemo.label: How it works
GpsDemo.subtitle: A small GPS device in your vehicle sends its location every few seconds. You see it live in the Trakway app — plus alerts that keep it safe and save you money.
GpsDemo.liveDesc: Watch every vehicle move on the map in real time.
GpsDemo.theftDesc: Instant alerts for ignition, tampering and towing.
GpsDemo.geofenceDesc: Know the moment a vehicle enters or leaves a zone.
GpsDemo.historyDesc: Replay routes, stops and distance for any day.
GpsDemo.driverDesc: Spot overspeeding and harsh braking to cut fuel costs.
GpsDemo.appDesc: Track from your phone, tablet or laptop.
